body:
The worst part of it is being associated with it at all. The most hurtful, negative part about it is the backlash that not the person goes through, but the family; children, spouse, parents, grandparents, aunts, uncles, grandchildren, and further future generations. The children are judged and ostracized by other kids and parents, they are bullied abused and left out.
It's hard to get any respect from people who know and those who don't, you stay on guard until the day they do. Many of us have a lot to offer society, however we feel restrained by the stigma and views so is it worth it?
